title: The Farmhouse at Annie Acres
description:
If you're looking for a full hands-on farm experience look no more! 72 acres of rolling hills, farm life, the rawness of nature and the peaceful valleys make up Annie Acres.  Less than 10 miles from downtown Nashville, and 2.1 miles to Briley parkway that gives you access to West End, Green Hills, Berry Hill, Opryland and BNA Airport,  to name a few popular areas.  Beaman Park is right down the street, with a nature center and some great hiking trails
Infants and toddlers count towards occupancy

Guest access
You may park anywhere in the gravel area in front of the house. You enter the house from the front left side.

Other things to note
There are absolutely NO PARTIES which include BACHELORETTE!!!!!! NO WEDDING PARTY’S. 

Infants and toddlers count towards guest total. Max occupancy is 6 set by codes department.
